<!-- pr-reviewer: 51a718772975425ab9df0524a5d559262abc3548 -->
Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4166 (config ~/.claude-bob), claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers found. This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code.

### What the PR does

- `assets/posts/sinumerik-810m.cps`: a new `arcAxes()` writes the two plane axes first on a G18 arc (X Z) and on a G19 arc (Y Z).
- The out-of-plane axis comes last, and only when its posted word changes (`axisMoved()`). It compares the end word with `StartX`/`StartY`. When the stream has no start value, it uses the tracked position. When it knows neither, it writes the axis.
- G17 arcs are not changed (`xyz()` as before).
- This does what #4146 asks for.

### What looks good

- The "is it helical" test compares the formatted words after the origin subtraction. Thus an axis that moves by less than the output resolution does not write a word, and a real move always writes one.
- The fallback is safe. An unknown start writes the axis, as the old output did.
- `I`/`J`/`K` are not changed. Only the order of the axis words and the omitted static axis change.
- The golden diff is minimal. The pinning test adds one helical G18 arc and one helical G19 arc, so the "third axis last" branch has a pin.

### Goldens moved (checked line by line)

`crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/sinumerik-810m/arcs.nc`, 3 lines:

| Old | New | Check |
|---|---|---|
| `G18 G2 X20 Y20 Z-10 I10 K0 F600` | `G18 G2 X20 Z-10 I10 K0 F600` | The start Y is 20 (previous block `G2 X10 Y20 Z0`). Y does not move, so Y is correctly omitted. |
| `G19 G3 X20 Y30 Z-20 J10 K0 F600` | `G19 G3 Y30 Z-20 J10 K0 F600` | The start X is 20. X does not move, so X is correctly omitted. |
| `G3 X20 Y30 Z0 J0 K10 F600` | `G3 Y30 Z0 J0 K10 F600` | G19 is modal. The start X is 20, so X is correctly omitted. |

No other recorded program changed. The app goldens under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sinumerik-810m/` and `synth_sinumerik-810m.nc` have no G18/G19 blocks and stay byte-identical (the `conformance` suite is green).

### Results (local, trial merge with upstream/main `e6849c5ae`)

Built and run locally on macOS (Apple Silicon). The trial merge was clean. HEAD^1 is the PR head `51a718772`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **164 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled** (9.7 min). This includes all post suites, `script_sinumerik_810m`, `sinumerik_810m_post` (post and app), `conformance`, `wcs_flip_dialects`, `arc_planes`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`.
- Pinning tests by name: `camcraft-post --test sinumerik_810m_post` 11/11 pass (with `arcs_comp_and_dwell_match_810m_dialect`), `--test script_sinumerik_810m` 11/11 pass (with `arcs`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed (5.6 min).
- Heavy lanes: not run. This is a P3 PR, and AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives a P3 PR no heavy step.

**Extra suites run:** none were owed. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code.

### Mutations (each one on the PR head, then restored)

1. Change `onCircular` back to `xyz(properties)`: the `arcs` golden goes **red**.
2. Make `axisMoved()` always return `false` (never write the third axis): `arcs_comp_and_dwell_match_810m_dialect` goes **red** at `sinumerik_810m_post.rs:281` (the helical G18 pin).
3. Make `axisMoved()` always return `true` (always write the third axis): the `arcs` golden goes **red**.

The tests pin the two branches of the change in both directions.

### Law check

- Prime Directive: the change has no Rust code. The script has no new refusal path and no silent drop. An unknown start position writes the axis.
- Clean-room: the new comment is original text. The file keeps its provenance header.
- Commit: `fix(post): ...`, and the body ends with `Fixes #4146`. The PR body has a `Changelog:` line.
- No process file, no snapshot PNG, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no dependency change.

### Optional, non-blocking

1. PR body: AGENTS.md asks that the body ends with `Fixes #4146`. At the moment the `Changelog:` line comes after it. GitHub still closes the issue. Also, a "Goldens moved" heading and a "not exercised" line help the next reader. For example: "not run on an 810M control; the axis order comes from the issue and the SINUMERIK audit #4130".
2. `crates/post/tests/sinumerik_810m_post.rs:258-267`: the two new helical arcs are not geometrically consistent. The G18 arc has a start radius of 10 and an end radius of 2, and the G19 arc has a start radius of 8 and an end radius of 2. The post does not check the radius, so the test is still valid for the word order. A consistent arc is more correct if a radius check comes to this post later.

### Next step

@JSwetz, the review is clean. Please mark the PR ready (`gh pr ready 4166`), so that it can merge on this review.
